title: JavaScript Service Worker Offline Caching
title_es: Service Worker Offline Caching en JavaScript
description: Minimal PWA offline demo: service worker registration, app-shell precache, cache-first fetch with navigation fallback, and background sync replay of a queued form over IndexedDB
description_es: Demo mínima de PWA offline: registro del service worker, precaché del app shell, fetch cache-first con respaldo de navegación y reintento por background sync de un formulario encolado en IndexedDB
